ad_library.summary: Hysun Solar Pvt Ltd is live on both channels - one Google ad behind a verified account (AR08880526109242818561) and Meta ads selling the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy to Hyderabad homeowners. The split matters: the Google ad points at hysunsolar.com, while every Meta click is captured inside a WhatsApp chat or Facebook lead form. This business was first swept on 2026-10-18 as lead #1 of batch 2 and never promoted into the pipeline; this report closes that gap. The site itself is a largely unmodified template - repeated 'Harness the Sun Get Solar Power Today!' headings and a 'Free contact 24/7' block - and it publishes an Ahmedabad address while the ads target Hyderabad.

funnel.type: Split - own site on Google, lead form on Meta
funnel.meaning: The Google side of the spend is measurable; the Meta side is not. Every Meta rupee ends inside Facebook's form or a WhatsApp thread, so there is no pixel, no retargeting pool and no page to test a different price on.

findings: Meta ads sell the Rs.78,000 subsidy and EMI to Hyderabad homeowners, but every click lands in a WhatsApp chat or Facebook lead form - the Meta spend never reaches hysunsolar.com.

The contact page publishes an Ahmedabad address (10 Radhekrishna Ind Hub, B/H Hinglaj Mata Mandir, Ahmedabad) while the ads target Suncity, Bandlaguda Jagir, Hyderabad 500091. A Hyderabad homeowner checking the site after clicking an ad sees the wrong city.

Three different contact routes are live at once: info@hysunsolar.com on the site, infohysunsolar@gmail.com as the support address on their own Android app (com.HYSUN.HysunSolar), and +91 7573999960 on the Meta ads against +91 7573999966 on the site. Enquiries can land in an inbox nobody watches.

The site is a template with repeated 'Harness the Sun Get Solar Power Today!' headings and a 'Free contact 24/7' block - no project photos, no system sizing table, nothing that qualifies the lead the ads are paying for.
The Android app advertises one-tap service requests, panel cleaning and a dedicated support team - an operational strength that no ad or web page mentions.
next_steps: Send the Meta clicks to a page you own
A dedicated PM Surya Ghar landing page with the subsidy, an enquiry form and the Meta Pixel turns the current lead-form spend into a measurable, retargetable audience.
Fix the city on the contact page
An Ahmedabad address under ads that say Bandlaguda Jagir, Hyderabad costs trust at exactly the moment a homeowner is deciding whether to call.
Three addresses and two phone numbers is three chances to miss an enquiry. Point everything at one monitored inbox and one number.
One-tap service requests and panel cleaning are already built into the app. They are the differentiator against every other lead-form advertiser in the Hyderabad feed.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Live ads click to a Facebook lead form (fb.me) - traffic never reaches a page you own, so no URL can carry UTMs and click data stays inside Meta.

controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started Active 2026-11-14) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: A single live ad - no internal comparison, no safety net if it fatigues.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
